EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ Accrual Discrepancy Manual Adjustment
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Time and Attendance Support. I'm happy to assist with your question today! You can review an employee’s accrual transactions balance by following the steps below:
Select the employee in the drop-down menu
Navigate to Employee Maintenance > Employee Information > Accrual Summary > Transactions (tab)
Select the appropriate accrual type in the “Accrual Type” field
Select “Current Year” in the “View Range” field or the desired date range
When selecting the desired date range, you can view all transactions within those dates to view what they have already accrued. You can compare the amount that they received to the amount they should have been awarded. Once you’ve determined the accrual amount discrepancy, you can make a manual accrual adjustment to reflect that difference in their accrual balance. You can access our Help Center for guidance on making manual accrual adjustments here.
Please let us know if you have additional questions, and we’ll be glad to help.
Thank you,
